difficulty.label: basic_learning
difficulty.rationale: Two sequential steps: compute the predicted value at x=16 (28.79), then residual = actual - predicted = 13.4 - 28.79 = -15.39. This is below the 3-step threshold for exam_prep. Distractors include the predicted value, the reversed sign, and a wrong-sum option. Arithmetic is light and the stem is short, so there are no unfair sources.

difficulty.label: basic_learning
difficulty.rationale: Standard description of a scatterplot (direction, form, strength, unusual point) using the plot and given r. Requires recognizing negative direction, linear form, moderate-strong r, and spotting the highlighted point as an outlier (13.4 vs about 28.6 at a similar x). No computation; short stem; distractors are clearly wrong on direction, outlier presence, or form. This is foundational skill 4.A for topic 5.1.

difficulty.label: basic_learning
difficulty.rationale: The item takes 2 steps: recognize the highlighted point as a vertical outlier, then see that its mid-range x-value gives low leverage and little influence on the slope. Removing it strengthens r and barely changes the slope. By the rubric, 2 or fewer steps means basic_learning, even though two concepts (outlier, influence) are involved. There is no arithmetic, the stem is short, and the scatterplot is simple to read, so no unfair difficulty sources.
